dct_description_sm: The general objective of this study is to determine the influence of environmental factors on the phytoplankton distribution in the High Canadian Arctic and to perform a long-term monitoring of these communities. As part of the NetCare project, included in this year's cruise, we also have as a second objective to identify the key players for DMS production in melt ponds and along ice margins.
dct_title_s: Production, biomass, abundance and taxonomic composition of phytoplankton in Baffin Bay, Canadian Arctic Archipelago and Beaufort sea during the summer and fall 2014
